versions.changelog: Adds a cost note and pricing links so people know the first scan is free and more scans need a plan. Fixes the broken privacy link in the README.
The agent now gets the scan result by itself: it gives you a link with a one-time code, you tap Send to my agent after the scan, and it picks the numbers up. COPY_TEXT stays as the fallback.
1.4.0: presets for before-and-after (pre/post workout, before a call, two-minute reset) with a context field, and a casual session_note in the JSON.
